title: Term Features of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons: Free Look, Removal, Renewal and Transfer
content:
For each rider of the Optional Coverage Add-Ons Bridgewell publishes a free-look period and four term features: whether the rider can be removed during the base term, whether removal from an annually billed base credits the unused rider premium, whether the rider renews automatically with the base contract, and whether it moves with the base contract on an ownership transfer.

| Rider | Free-look period (calendar days after the rider is added) | Removable during the base term | Removal from an annually billed base credits unused rider premium | Renews with the base contract | Moves with the base contract on an ownership transfer |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Second Refrigerator Rider | 30 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Bridgewell Septic System Rider | 30 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Bridgewell Well Pump Rider | 30 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Bridgewell Limited Roof Leak Rider | 30 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Bridgewell Pool Equipment Rider | 30 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Bridgewell Pool and Spa Equipment Rider | 30 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Bridgewell Guest Unit Rider | 30 | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

## The free-look period as published

The free-look period is the number of calendar days after the rider is added within which removal returns all rider premium paid less rider benefit paid. Every rider publishes 30 days.

## Points of reference

**Is any rider fixed for the whole base term?** No. All seven riders show "Yes" for removal during the base term.

**Does any rider stay behind when the base contract renews or is transferred?** No. All seven riders show "Yes" for renewal with the base contract and for moving with it on an ownership transfer.
